sql_templates.description: Calculate index returns over the last 3 months.
sql_templates.query: SELECT index_symbol, MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date, (MAX(close) - MIN(close)) / MIN(close) * 100 AS return_pct FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') GROUP BY index_symbol;

sql_templates.description: Get the current stage distribution by sector.
sql_templates.query: SELECT sector, stage, COUNT(symbol) AS count FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) GROUP BY sector, stage;

sql_templates.description: Identify the leading sectors with the highest average stage score.
sql_templates.query: SELECT sector, AVG(stage_score) AS avg_stage_score FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) AND stage = 'STAGE_2' GROUP BY sector ORDER BY avg_stage_score DESC LIMIT 5;

sql_templates.description: List the top 10 primary swing candidates based on VCP score.
sql_templates.query: SELECT symbol, company_name, vcp_score FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks) ORDER BY vcp_score DESC LIMIT 10;
